svg.title: About
svg.desc: I build billing systems for AI infrastructure at CoreWeave — mostly Go on Kubernetes. Not a tools team; still obsessed with DevX and CI/CD. Earlier: AWS boto3 maintainer, then backend at The New York Times. NYC native. Reliable systems + feedback loops engineers can trust.
